answer: Here is one mechanism that works: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because ember only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, vine is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any dune approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
